strategy.customers: Medium and large enterprises, multinationals, information-intensive businesses, and service providers; smaller businesses reached through channel partners.
strategy.why_we_win: It combines owned infrastructure, broad international reach, low-latency reliable performance, flexible scaling, and strong multilingual support to simplify complex communications and IT needs.
strategy.resources: Owned fibre networks, metropolitan footprints, carrier-neutral data centres, software platforms, specialist engineers, regulatory know-how, and round-the-clock service operations.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward smarter software-defined, high-bandwidth, integrated infrastructure services with real-time provisioning and support for cloud adoption and digital growth.

strategy.offer: Managed connectivity, voice, cloud access, cybersecurity, contact centre and unified communications services, with self-service and on-demand options.
strategy.customers: Organisations needing secure business communications and digital infrastructure, including enterprises, public-facing operations, and service providers operating across multiple sites or countries.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues customers prefer a single provider combining strong service experience, intelligent automation, reliable performance, security, and consistent delivery across regions.
strategy.resources: Its basis is owned network infrastructure, software-defined capabilities, broad cloud and technology partnerships, operational support tools, and a large multilingual workforce.
strategy.direction: It aims to expand connectivity coverage and become the industry's most customer-oriented partner for digital transformation and hybrid cloud working.
